title: melampyrum nemorosum subsp. velebiticum
intro: Melampyrum nemorosum subsp. velebiticum, commonly known as the Croatian yellow monkey flower, is a plant species within the family Orobanchaceae. As a hemiparasitic plant, it obtains some of its nutrients by parasitizing the roots of other plants, while also being capable of photosynthesis. The health benefits of Melampyrum nemorosum subsp. velebiticum are not extensively documented, but its extracts have been studied for their potential therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which may contribute to its potential medicinal effects.
